lyrics:
0 God, my God, for You my soul Is thirsting.

1. 0 God. You are my God, for You I long,
For You my soul is thirsting.

2. Like a dry weary land without water,
My body pines for You, 0 Lord.

3. So I gaze on You in the sanctuary,
To see Your strength and Your glory.

4. For Your love is better than life itself,
My lips will loudly speak Your praise.
